programme.desc: Ever owned a cat that would be perfect starring in the feline version of `Psycho'? You know, a pet that wreaks havoc on a household to the point of breaking up relationships, or one whose violent actions sends its owners to the hospital? Cat behaviourist Jackson Galaxy deals with these issues every day, and in this series he lends his expertise to desperate families hoping to rehabilitate their furry companions.
programme.title: My Cat From Hell

programme.desc: Veteran bear trainer Jeff Watson takes on perhaps his toughest task in more than 25 years of rescuing and raising the majestic animals. His goal - to reverse the cycle of man's ownership over animals - involves 700-pound grizzlies Bob and Screech, whom he has raised since they were 6 weeks old. Now, after three years, Jeff believes their destiny is to live in the wild, and `Project Grizzly' tracks the trainer's emotional struggle to undo all he has taught the bears in captivity. At a remote Indiana location, Bob and Screech must learn how to hunt, fish and hibernate, and ultimately break their dependence on a human. Unforeseen hurdles lead to some doubt, but Jeff is determined to complete this incredible, dangerous challenge.
programme.title: Project Grizzly

programme.desc: If your idea of an exciting aquarium is the run-of-the-mill rectangular variety with a few exotic fish thrown in, you're not welcome in the wet and wonderful world of Wayde King and Brett Raymer. The brothers-in-law, best friends and business partners operate Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the biggest aquarium-building manufacturer in the US. `Tanked' showcases the guys, their family members who also work at ATM and the shop's crew as they create over-the-top aquariums for a wide array of clients, both celebrities and regular folks. The tanks range from 50 to 50,000 gallons in size, are filled with some of the world's most unusual, colourful and quirky fish, and are limited only by one's imagination.
programme.title: Tanked

programme.desc: A mix of detective work and medical emergency rescues make up the daily grind for investigators and emergency animal medical technicians at the Arizona Humane Society who do their utmost to protect the interests of animals in Phoenix.
programme.title: Animal Cops: Phoenix

programme.desc: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions.
programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins

programme.desc: `Pit Bulls and Parolees' follows the work of Tia Torres, a renowned pit bull trainer and founder of the Villalobos Rescue Center. The rehabilitation and placement centre houses hundreds of abused and abandoned dogs of all breeds, and the centre has a crew of paroled felons who help Torres and her daughters Tania and Mariah care for the animals. It is a chance at redemption for both man and man's best friend.
programme.title: Pit Bulls and Parolees

programme.desc: Animal Planet expands its family of wildlife law enforcement series, adding to Maine's `North Woods Law' an offering that follows an elite patrol force in Texas. `Lone Star Law' features the men and women of the Texas Game Wardens who protect more than a quarter-million square miles of deserts, lakes, piney woods, bayous, plains and coast in the second-largest state in the US. Whether rushing to investigate poaching cases, save flash-flood victims, disrupt illegal smuggling rings, or rescue injured wildlife, the officers are always on the go, defending both animals and citizens.
programme.title: Lone Star Law

programme.desc: Jeff Young has 80,000 friends in Denver, Colorado. That's about the number of clients - people and their pets - he serves as the popular owner/lead veterinarian of Planned Pethood Plus, one of the busiest animal clinics in the U.S. This poignant series reveals some of the riveting cases that Dr Jeff and his team of 30 veterinary experts respond to with precision, compassion and speed in an often tense, chaotic atmosphere. The staff juggle routine pet visits with several dozen daily crucial surgeries and emergencies. For animals in need outside of the clinic, Dr Jeff finds time to take his services on the road, visiting farm and ranch animals in far-reaching communities and reservations within Colorado, neighbouring states and beyond.
programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet

programme.desc: People who know and work with Pete Nelson describe him as a tree whisperer. For his part, Nelson lets the trees do the talking. He's a world-renowned treehouse designer and builder, and this series documents the work he and his team of craftsmen - including his son Charlie - do to create incredible homes and businesses in nature's canopy. Pete uses a combination of science and art to realize clients' sky-high aspirations of magnificent multibedroom treehouses with elaborate kitchens and bathrooms, or simpler, peaceful one-room escapes. Other backyard above-ground spaces featured in the series include a spa retreat, a brewery, and a honeymoon suite. "We awaken that inner child who dreams of living among the trees," Pete says.
programme.title: Treehouse Masters

programme.desc: Anthony Archer-Wills is the Pete Nelson of pool design. Nelson stars in Animal Planet's popular `Treehouse Masters', creating hideaways in the limbs of oaks and maples. Archer-Wills works on the ground as a world-renowned builder of swimming pools but uses the same creativity and respect for ecology. In `The Pool Master', the charming Brit has unfaltering enthusiasm for his work - rivaled only by his love of a cool gin and tonic. He designs and executes unique and stunning pools that seem to be formed by nature. His goal is "to support the environment, provide homes to beds of aquatic plants, and foster elements of mystery," which enhance the experience of swimming.
programme.title: The Pool Master

programme.desc: The breathtaking beauty of Alaska sometimes hides the fact its winters can be incredibly harsh, especially for those who live in the state's outlying areas. `Alaska: The Last Frontier' perfectly illustrates this reality, as the programme profiles life for the Kilcher family in the isolated community of Homer. For four generations the Kilchers have lived off what their 600-acre homestead has provided, but cultivating that living is never easy. Led by patriarch Atz Kilcher and his brother Otto, the family spends the short summer and fall gardening, hunting and fishing for food, gathering supplies from the land and preparing their animals for the winter. Viewers, who may or may not have a fancy phone by their side while watching on their big-screen high-def TV, also see the Kilchers living off the grid, where running water and electricity aren't daily staples, nor is contact with the outside world. Atz, by the way, is the father of music superstar Jewel, who does not appear on the show.
programme.title: Alaska: The Last Frontier

programme.desc: Architect Danny Forster travels around the world to "deconstruct" such ultimate construction projects as warships, public works structures, cruise liners and extreme thrill rides. Forster takes viewers inside the head-scratching builds, interviewing on-site architects and engineers to provide a fresh perspective on complex construction techniques and unique architectural challenges. He also tries his hand at some of the jobs at each site and samples the latest computer graphics to gain a greater understanding of the scope and scale of each project.

programme.desc: `Combat Dealers' follows military kit enthusiast Bruce Crompton as he collects, restores and sells World War II artefacts. Always looking to turn a profit, Bruce and his team of experts travel far and wide to uncover military treasures that have a fascinating history. Hus is the `money man' with second-to-none haggling skills that come in handy when trading with trucks, tanks and trailers. Back at Bruce's farm in Sussex, twins Nick and Phil, along with ex-paratrooper Freddy, repair and refurbish the relics back into fully functioning machines.
programme.title: Combat Dealers

programme.desc: Intrigued by legendary mysteries and driven by curiosity, Josh Gates is on a mission for answers. `Exhibition Unknown' chronicles his global adventures as he investigates iconic unsolved events, lost cities, buried treasures and other puzzling stories. Armed with a degree in archaeology, a quick wit and a thirst for action, Gates investigates recent developments before embarking on a detailed exploration. Whether he's trekking through Fiji in search of Amelia Earhart's remains or diving the deep seas of Panama to locate Captain Morgan's pirate ship, Gates' roughshod expeditions lead him one step closer to the truth.

programme.desc: NASA's task of reaching beyond the bounds of Earth has uncovered disturbing anomalies that have perplexed even the finest scientific minds. Science Channel digs into the space agency's archives to reveal countless mysteries and unusual encounters, discoveries and sightings. Each hour-long episode scrutinizes evidence, explores possible explanations, and considers testimony from NASA insiders, scientists, astronauts and others who have witnessed the strange phenomena. The stories are made all the more unusual since they come from the most credible scientific organisation in the world.
programme.title: NASA's Unexplained Files

programme.desc: `How the Universe Works' is an ultimate cosmos operator's manual, a revealing look at the inner workings of outer space. Computer imagery allows viewers to explore black holes, supernovae, neutron stars, dark energy and all the other forces that produce what is and what we see.
programme.title: How the Universe Works

programme.desc: According to a legend that dates back to the 16th century, a cache of Incan gold worth hundreds of millions of dollars is hidden off the coast of southeastern Brazil. It's known as the `Treasure of the Trinity', and it's eluded all who have sought it for 500 years. But a modern-day team of explorers follows a radical new theory to uncover its whereabouts: a remote, treacherous island where thousands of deadly vipers roam. On the expedition to Queimada Grande - known to locals as Snake Island - the hunters are armed with advanced technology to unearth complex clues and decipher puzzles that have protected the treasure for centuries. This Discovery series takes viewers along on the epic journey to one of the most dangerous places on Earth.
programme.title: Treasure Quest: Snake Island

programme.desc: The extraordinary, often bizarre treasures housed in America's museums represent wondrous chapters in history, but a physical display can tell only part of their story. Behind each artefact are amazing tales and secrets to be revealed - tales sometimes brimming with scandal, mystery, murder and intrigue. In `Mysteries at the Museum', presenter Don Wildman visits a wide variety of museums across the United States, taking viewers on a sometimes shocking tour of America's past by re-examining what's been left behind. Interviews, archival footage and re-enactments bring to life the artefacts' enduring mysteries, some that have never been told before on television.
programme.title: Mysteries at the Museum

Interviews, archival footage and re-enactments bring to life the artefacts' enduring mysteries, some that have never been told before on television.

Hus is the `money man' with second-to-none haggling skills that come in handy when trading with trucks, tanks and trailers. programme.desc: Motorbike enthusiast Henry Cole and specialist Fuzz Townshend travel around the UK to explore people's sheds in the hope of uncovering some automotive bargains. Together with the expert help of Lovegrove, the pair fix the vehicles and transform them into functional machines, ready to sell on. Will they will be able to turn a profit on their financial and labour-intensive investments? On their way from Cornwall to Oxfordshire, they discover vintage tractors and meet the owner who has turned their cottage into a transport museum. Moving onto Surrey, they come across some Pontiac ambulances and some unusual sculptures made from auto parts.

programme.desc: Former aerospace engineer Justin Cunningham and his team of reporters explore the world's most bizarre engineering mistakes and set about finding workable solutions to these problems. programme.desc: Considered one of NASA's original space pioneers, astronaut Gordon Cooper discovered something extraordinary on a 1963 mission. While circling Earth during a 122-hour flight to detect nuclear sites, Cooper photographed more than 100 anomalies around the South Caribbean. He later believed the dark patches that appeared on the photos to be sunken ships, and while working for decades in secret, Gordon created a map that he thought could uncover treasures worth billions of dollars. Before passing away, he shared his meticulous research with longtime friend Darrell Miklos, and now Miklos is teaming with seasoned explorers and researchers to finally make good on Gordon's dream.
programme.title: Cooper's Treasure

programme.desc: If your idea of an exciting aquarium is the run-of-the-mill rectangular variety with a few exotic fish thrown in, you're not welcome in the wet and wonderful world of Wayde King and Brett Raymer. The brothers-in-law, best friends and business partners operate Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the biggest aquarium-building manufacturer in the US. `Tanked' showcases the guys, their family members who also work at ATM and the shop's crew as they create over-the-top aquariums for a wide array of clients, both celebrities and regular folks. The tanks range from 50 to 50,000 gallons in size, are filled with some of the world's most unusual, colourful and quirky fish, and are limited only by one's imagination.
programme.title: Tanked

programme.desc: People who know and work with Pete Nelson describe him as a tree whisperer. For his part, Nelson lets the trees do the talking. He's a world-renowned treehouse designer and builder, and this series documents the work he and his team of craftsmen - including his son Charlie - do to create incredible homes and businesses in nature's canopy. Pete uses a combination of science and art to realize clients' sky-high aspirations of magnificent multibedroom treehouses with elaborate kitchens and bathrooms, or simpler, peaceful one-room escapes. Other backyard above-ground spaces featured in the series include a spa retreat, a brewery, and a honeymoon suite. "We awaken that inner child who dreams of living among the trees," Pete says.
programme.title: Treehouse Masters

programme.desc: The boys are back in Alaska (although Discovery dropped the state's mention in the title after the first season) hoping to strike it rich mining for gold. Their first effort was anything but rich and glorious, however, as the crew led by Todd Hoffman and his father, Jack, sunk $250,000 into their dream and came away with just $20,000 worth of gold. The dismal summer was filled with injuries, malfunctioning equipment and constant fighting among the greenhorn miners, yet their serious case of gold fever trumps any talk of giving up and leads to a new operating plan in order to salvage their dream. The series also keeps tabs on the efforts of teenager Parker Schnabel and old-timer Dakota Fred to hit the mother lode at separate sites.
programme.title: Gold Rush

programme.desc: Idyllic in nature, the concept of living a scaled-down, simpler, off-the-grid life has gained popularity in recent years, but the initial results for many budding homesteaders have been disappointing. The learning curve is steep, especially in the most dangerous and isolated locations across America. Many families are not equipped with the skills, experience or knowledge of how to grow food, find water, harness power or deal with the threat of predators. In `Homestead Rescue', craftsman and survival expert Marty Raney - joined by daughter Misty, a farmer, and son Matt, a hunter and fisherman - attempt to teach these families the essential skills on how to survive - and thrive - in the wilderness. Because sustaining a homestead through hunting, fishing, gardening, building upkeep, security, and problem solving is a full-time job. At the conclusion of each episode, the rookie survivalists decide to either tough out their first year or pack up and return to civilization.
programme.title: Homestead Rescue

programme.desc: Car enthusiast Mike Brewer works alongside mechanics to give new life to rundown, classic automobiles in order to resell at a profit. Once complete, the restored car is taken for a test drive, and then Mike negotiates the purchase price with a new owner. The first 13 seasons of `Wheeler Dealers' featured master mechanic Edd China as Brewer's sidekick.

programme.title: Boundless
programme.desc: Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

programme.title: Boundless
programme.desc: Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

programme.title: Password
programme.desc: Starring Jimmy Fallon and hosted by Keke Palmer, the iconic word-guessing game features celebrities teaming up with everyday contestants. These teams play a modern and refreshed version of the game that's inspired by classic Password, Password Plus, Super Password and the viral celebrity Password games seen on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon. Players compete over three rounds of gameplay, taking turns trying to get their partner to guess the password using one-word clues. The team with the most points after two rounds heads to the bonus round, where they have 60 seconds to get the celebrity guests to correctly guess 10 passwords for a chance to win as much as $25,000.

programme.title: Password
programme.desc: Starring Jimmy Fallon and hosted by Keke Palmer, the iconic word-guessing game features celebrities teaming up with everyday contestants. These teams play a modern and refreshed version of the game that's inspired by classic Password, Password Plus, Super Password and the viral celebrity Password games seen on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon. Players compete over three rounds of gameplay, taking turns trying to get their partner to guess the password using one-word clues. programme.desc: Bart, a black railroad worker is appointed sheriff of a town marked for destruction by Hedley Lamarr, a scheming politician. As Lamarr tries to drive out the town's residents, Bart decides to stand in his way.
programme.title: Blazing Saddles

programme.desc: Lighthearted adventures of a pair of news vendors in New York - one deaf, one blind - who go on the run when they are blamed for the murder of a customer. Each has seen - or heard - just a whiff of a clue, and a frantic chase ensues as the duo struggle to clear their names.
programme.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil

programme.desc: A teen suffers the pain of adolescence as she longs for Mr Right while fending off the advances of the class clown.
programme.title: Sixteen Candles

programme.desc: An out-of-work actor dresses in drag for an audition, only to land the female lead in a TV soap. When he becomes the most popular character on the show, he feels compelled to carry the persona into his everyday life. While bringing him phenomenal success as an `actress', life as a woman also has its problems - especially when he falls for an actress with whom he works.
programme.title: Tootsie

programme.desc: When one-time rock hopeful Robbie is jilted at the altar, he vents his bitterness in song, even when singing at other people's weddings. Only true love can redeem the broken-hearted songster but fortunately, he's about to meet a woman who will spin him right round (like a record).
programme.title: The Wedding Singer

programme.desc: An unconventional sleuth attempts to find a football team's stolen mascot dolphin. The Miami Dolphins are aghast when their beloved Snowflake is abducted one week before the all-important Super Bowl, so they call in Ace Ventura, a private eye who uses unorthodox methods to retrieve missing animals.
programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective

programme.desc: Legendary pet detective Ace Ventura returns for another adventure when he's coerced out of retirement while on a soul-searching retreat in the Himalayas. He must now retrieve an endangered white bat from a village located in Africa. The sacred animal was offered up as a wedding dowry from the Wachootoo prince to the Wachati princess, and, if Ace can't track down the culprit behind the kidnapping in time, civil war will break out between the two rival tribes.
programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls

programme.desc: A thirtysomething slacker attempts to inject some stability into his life by adopting an impressionable five-year-old.
programme.title: Big Daddy

programme.desc: Fastidious businessman Neal Page and slobbish shower-curtain salesman Del Griffith are the reluctant odd couple trying to get home from New York to Chicago to be with their families at Thanksgiving. Their thwarted travel plans keep throwing them together.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.desc: With Wednesday and Pugsley off to summer camp, a greedy nanny plots to marry and murder wealthy Uncle Fester.
programme.title: Addams Family Values

programme.desc: A ten-year-old boy befriends and shelters a gentle alien creature who has been stranded on Earth. When the authorities are alerted to this unusual house guest, the boy tries to help the creature return home before menacing government agents close in. The film won three Academy Awards for music, sound and special effects.
programme.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial

programme.desc: Grown-up Peter Pan has to return to Neverland to rediscover his true identity in order to rescue his children from the clutches of the evil Captain Hook. Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.
programme.title: Hook

programme.desc: Epic tale in which an intrepid archaeologist tries to beat a band of Nazis to a unique religious relic which is central to their plans for world domination. Battling against a snake phobia and a vengeful ex-girlfriend, Indiana Jones is in constant peril, making hair's-breadth escapes at every turn in this celebration of the innocent adventure movies of an earlier era.
programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark

programme.desc: Adventure sequel. Intrepid archaeologist Indiana Jones, on the trail of fortune and glory in Old Shanghai, is ricocheted into a dangerous adventure in India. With his faithful companion Short Round and nightclub singer Willie Scott, Indie goes in search of the magical Sankara stone, and uncovers an ancient evil which threatens all who come into contact with it.
programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom

programme.desc: The intrepid explorer Indiana Jones sets out to rescue his father, a medievalist who has vanished while searching for the Holy Grail. Following clues in the old man's notebook, Indy arrives in Venice, where he enlists the help of a beautiful academic, but they are not the only ones who are on the trail, and some sinister old enemies soon come out of the woodwork.
programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade

programme.desc: On his return from the Crusades, Robin of Locksley learns that his father has been murdered by the tyrannical Sheriff of Nottingham and embarks on a campaign of guerrilla warfare to protect King Richard's throne. Fight scenes are lively and inventive, and a set piece fought under the forest canopy pulls out all the stops.
programme.title: Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves

programme.desc: Vietnam veteran John J Rambo is pushed too far by the sheriff of a small American town. After being wrongfully arrested, he escapes and leads lawmen and an army detachment on a chase through the mountains.
programme.title: First Blood

programme.desc: War veteran John Rambo takes on the entire Vietnamese army, plus Soviet advisers, when he is released from prison and sent back to present-day Vietnam in search of American prisoners of war still being held in enemy custody.
programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II

programme.desc: Reluctant one-man army Rambo goes into action against brutal Soviet invaders in Afghanistan. Sought out in a Buddhist monastery retreat, Rambo declines his former commander's request for help to deliver missiles to the mujahideen, but when his superior is captured and imprisoned, the hulking hero brings out the big guns.
programme.title: Rambo III

programme.desc: A CIA agent comes up against a duplicitous American government during his quest to nab a Colombian drug lord.

programme.desc: Sinbad sails to the island of Colossa to rescue a beautiful princess from an evil sorcerer's spell. Once there, he does battle with a succession of marvellous creatures.
programme.title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad

programme.desc: Batman battles super-villain Mr Freeze and seductive eco-terrorist Poison Ivy. programme.desc: A teenage video-game whiz is recruited as an interstellar fighter pilot by an emissary from a league of planets.

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S10 E13 — The One Where Joey Speaks French Monica and Chandler discover that their prospective adoptive child's biological father may be a 'shovel killer', Ross and Rachel get dangerously close when they go to visit her sick father, and Phoebe struggles to teach Joey French for an audition.
programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S1 E1 — The Rise to Power At the end of a bloody civil war, Francisco Franco seized power and ruled Spain with an iron hand for nearly four decades. Under his leadership the conservative, monarchist armed forces staged a coup against Spain's republican government which had been democratically elected. The insurrection was supported by Italy and Germany. Three years of bitter civil war followed which, by April 1939, had turned Spain into a different country. The hostilities and political purges cost half a million lives.
programme.title: The Truth about Franco: Spain's Forgotten Dictatorship

programme.desc: Naturalist David Attenborough heads to London's Natural History Museum - a place he has been visiting since he was a boy - to bring some of his favourite extinct creatures back to life in a groundbreaking special. The animals brought back to life range from long-extinct dinosaurs to creatures like the dodo that have become extinct more recently.

Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael shows us how to make an impossibly delicious brunch menu of Parm Frittata with tomato sauce, served with a side of sausage and a simple salad that you can serve all day.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Asian chef Kinsan and Laura make Japanese Vegetable Tempura in the Market Kitchen. Laura then prepares Chicken Schnitzel with Mushroom Sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Come spring, Lidia gets very excited to visit the market. The colour, the aromas, that first harvest, it all ignites her creative side to get cooking after a long winter.

programme.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
programme.desc: Hayden dives at sunrise for sea urchins, then he's off to a local farmers' market to buy mushrooms, grab some famous donuts, and cook for his friends on their goat farm.

programme.title: Freshly Picked With Simon Toohey
programme.desc: Hot and spicy is all the rage in today's episode. Rebecca Veale is back in the kitchen for crispy chilli stir fry, and Simon brings a spicy salad loaded with mouthwatering roasted radishes.

programme.title: Jamie's Great Italian Escape
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver arrives on the tiny Sicilian island of Marettimo. Here he meets fisherman Giovanni - the owner of one of Sicily's best restaurants - who has Jamie work as his assistant in his eatery.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: It's a beautifully buttery night on The Cook Up, as Adam is joined by croissant connoisseur Kate Reid and acclaimed chef Giovanni Pilu.

programme.title: Symon's Dinners Cooking Out
programme.desc: This traditional Tuscan dish is perfect for a summer's late lunch to carry you into an evening of relaxing. Michael Symon revamps some grilled chicken by glazing it with some floral vermouth.

programme.title: Paula McIntyre's Hamely Kitchen
programme.desc: Paula shows us how to make her version of steak diane by substituting the steak with a collop of venision which she roasts and serves with sauteed potatoes. She demonstrates how to smoke a chicken.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Vietnam
programme.desc: Chef Luke Nguyen visits the beachside town of Nha Trang, a coastal town abundant with fresh seafood - and prepares char grilled lobster right on the beach.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke heads to a coastal town to teach cooking skills to disabled children, who learn how to prepare fish cakes; Luke visits to a farmyard to learn how a family creates fresh tofu; local monks demonstrate how to cook a vegetarian meal.

programme.title: Planet Bbq
programme.desc: This show gives grilled and smoked vegetables their due; tandoori cauliflower with coriander mint chutney, squash gratin with habanero chiles, and Mexican pit-roasted lamb.

programme.title: Fun'q With Spencer Watts
programme.desc: The sun is shining and Spencer is turning up the heat, cooking delicious grilled food perfect to be served on a bun. He shares his secrets to the perfect grilled veggie burger and sesame meatloaf.

programme.title: Island Echoes With Nornie Bero
programme.desc: Nornie journeys to Hammond Island to explore its unique blend of cultures and rich history.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.sub-title: Grown Up Tomato Soup And Grilled Cheese
programme.desc: This classic combo from your youth gets an adult makeover and will make your mouth water. Rachael shows us her version of a creamy tomato soup and a spicy grilled cheese.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Guest chef Adam D'Sylva kicks off with his delicious Vietnamese Chicken and Bean Salad. Laura follows with Lamb and Feta Koftas with Flatbread and Yoghurt.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia always says, Let the ingredients shine! When you choose quality ingredients, it's best to let them speak for themselves.

programme.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
programme.desc: Hayden learns about regenerative farming at a cherry farm and a cattle property, with alpacas and a famous winery visit thrown in, and ends the day with a picture-perfect campfire meal.

programme.title: Freshly Picked With Simon Toohey
programme.desc: This episode of Freshly Picked is filled with delicious sweet treats. Monica Mignone returns with her carrot cake slice. Simon makes yummy biscuits with maple and tahini.

programme.title: Jamie's Great Italian Escape
programme.desc: Jamie heads north to the mountains of Le Marche - a relatively unexplored region next door to Umbria - to stay with a family of hunters.
